description:
Natural-hazard exposure for the suburb: how much of its area sits inside
a designated bushfire-prone area and inside a modelled flood overlay, each
with a plain risk band and the number of distinct hazard polygons.

Pass `geojson=true` to get the hazard shapes themselves, clipped to the
suburb boundary, in the same call. Slope, heritage, power lines and the
per-property hazard counts are separate calls.

geojson.description: When true, each sub-risk additionally carries a `geojson` FeatureCollection clipped to the suburb boundary — one call returns coverage plus every risk shape (default false — response unchanged).

name: suburbs_risks_all
title: Suburb · Bushfire + flood — bundle
